title: Vishvamitra arrives to take Rama along to guard his ritual
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra asks King Dasharatha to send Rama to protect the Vedic ritual that is being conducted by him, from the demons that are constantly disrupting it. The sage asserts King Dasharatha that he and the other sages in Dasharatha's court know the capabilities of Rama and though Rama is in his adolescence, he can easily kill the demons. But Dasharatha is upset at this request.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकोनविंशः सर्गः ||
Thus, this is the 19th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राजसिंहस्य वाक्यमद्भुतविस्तरम् |
हृष्टरोमा महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā rāja siṃhasya vākyam adbhuta vistaram |
hṛṣṭa romā mahātejā viśvāmitro'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: On listening the grand and detailed sentences of that King the lion Dasharatha, the great resplendent Sage Vishvamitra is thrilled with happiness and spoke this way.

verses.devanagari:
सदृशं राजशार्दूल तवैतद्भुवि नान्यथा |
महावंशप्रसूतस्य वसिष्ठव्यपदेशिनः
verses.iast:
sadṛśam rāja śārdūla tava eva bhuvi na anyataḥ |
mahāvaṃśa prasūtasya vasiṣṭha vyapadeśinaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, tigerly king, to you befitting are these words and to none else, as you are born in a great dynasty and tutored by Vashishta.

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु मे हृद्गतं वाक्यं तस्य कार्यस्य निश्चयम् |
कुरुष्व राजशार्दूल भव सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः
verses.iast:
yat tu me hṛd gatam vākyam tasya kāryasya niścayam |
kuruṣva rāja śārdūla bhava satya pratiśravaḥ
verses.translation: "What concerns I have in my heart I am going to say, and you take decision thereof, oh, tigerly-king, and become truthful to your promises.

glosses.meaning: my, heart, gone in = what I have in my heart
what is going to be said
of that, deed, decision, you take

verses.devanagari:
अहं नियममातिष्ठे सिद्ध्यर्थं पुरुषर्षभ |
तस्य विघ्नकरौ द्वौ तु राक्षसौ कामरूपिणौ
verses.iast:
aham niyamam ātiṣṭhe sidhdyartham puruṣa.rṣabha |
tasya vighnakarau dvau tu rākṣasau kāma rūpiṇau
verses.translation: "These days I am abiding by a sacrificial vow to attain a spiritual goal but, oh, best one among men, two guise changing demons as causing obstacles to that ritual.

glosses.meaning: I, to attain, a goal [of ascesis]
under a [sacrificial] vow, I am abiding by

verses.devanagari:
व्रते मे बहुशश्चीर्णे समाप्त्यां राक्षसाविमौ |
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ
तौ मांसरुधिरौघेण वेदिं तामभ्यवर्षताम् |
verses.iast:
vrate me bahuśaḥ cīrṇe samāptyām rākṣasāvimau |
mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca vīryavantau suśikṣitau
tau māṃsa rudhira ogheṇa vedim tām abhyavarṣatām |
verses.translation: "At the near end of almost completed ritual of mine two valiant and well-trained demons, namely Mareecha and Subaahu, are drenching the Altar of Fire with streams of meat and blood, from the sky.

glosses.meaning: that, Altar of Fire, from sky

verses.devanagari:
अवधूते तथाभूते तस्मिन्नियमनिश्चये
कृतश्रमो निरुत्साहस्तस्माद्देशादपाक्रमे |
verses.iast:
avadhūte tathā bhūte tasmin niyama niścaye
kṛta śramo nirutsāhaḥ tasmāt deśāt apākrame |
verses.translation: "When the ritual vow is thus ravaged I, as the one who exerted myself for the ritual, had to depart from that place, unenthusiastically.

glosses.meaning: I who made, an exertion of myself

verses.devanagari:
न च मे क्रोधमुत्स्रष्टुं बुद्धिर्भवति पार्थिव
तथाभूता हि सा चर्या न शापस्तत्र मुच्यते |
verses.iast:
na ca me krodham utsraṣṭum buddhiḥ bhavati pārthiva
tathā bhūtā hi sā caryā na śāpaḥ tatra mucyate |
verses.translation: "And to me there is no will to let loose my anger, oh, king, as no curse shall be issued under vows, and like that the activity during rituals shall be inoffensive, isn't it.

glosses.meaning: to me, will, is not, becoming - I have no will
that [kind of,] activity [during ritual,] like that, it will be [inoffensive,] isn't it

verses.devanagari:
स्वपुत्रं राजशार्दूल रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्
काकपक्षधरं शूरं ज्येष्ठं मे दातुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
sva putram rāja śārdūla rāmam satya parākramam
kāka pakṣa dharam śūram jyeṣṭham me dātum arhasi |
verses.translation: "As such, oh, tigerly king, it will be apt of you spare the services of that brave one whose valour itself is his truthfulness, that youngling whose hair locks are all the more jet black like crow wings on either side of his head, spare that eldest son of yours, namely Rama.

glosses.meaning: crows, wings, wearing - whose hair locks are like crow's wings, jet black, youngster
to me, to give [to spare services,] apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
शक्तो ह्येष मया गुप्तो दिव्येन स्वेन तेजसा
राक्षसा ये विकर्तारस्तेषामपि विनाशने |
verses.iast:
śakto hi yeṣa mayā gupto divyena svena tejasā
rākṣasā ye vikartāraḥ teṣām api vināśane |
verses.translation: "Indeed, he is capable to eradicate those demons that are thwarting the ritual by his own divine resplendence, and protected by me as well.

verses.devanagari:
श्रेयश्चास्मै प्रदास्यामि बहुरूपं न संशयः
त्रयाणामपि लोकानां येन ख्यातिं गमिष्यति |
verses.iast:
śreyaḥ ca asmai pradāsyāmi bahurūpam na saṃśayaḥ
trayāṇām api lokānām yena khyātim gamiṣyati |
verses.translation: "I will also accord many kinds of benefits to him by which he acquires renown in all the three worlds, no doubt about it.

verses.devanagari:
न च तौ राममासाद्य शक्तौ स्थातुं कथञ्चन
न च तौ राघवादन्यो हन्तुमुत्सहते पुमान् |
verses.iast:
na ca tau rāmam āsādya śaktau sthātum katham ca na
na ca tau rāghavāt anyo hantum utsahate pumān |
verses.translation: "Those two demons will be rendered incapable to stand fast on affronting Rama in anywise, and none other than Raghava has the fortitude to eliminate those two.

glosses.meaning: them two, to eliminate, do not, have fortitude.

verses.devanagari:
वीर्योत्सिक्तौ हि तौ पापौ कालपाशवशं गतौ
रामस्य राजशार्दूल न पर्याप्तौ महात्मनः |
verses.iast:
vīrya utsiktau hi tau pāpau kāla pāśa vaśam gatau
rāmasya rāja śārdūla na paryāptau mahātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Those two sinners that are berserk by their vigour have gone into the subjection of death's noose, oh tigerly king, cannot counterbalance the great-souled Rama.

glosses.meaning: by vigour, berserk, those two, sinners
Yama's [the Lord of Death,] noose's, subjugation, gone in
for great souled, Rama, not, enough - counterbalance.

verses.devanagari:
न च पुत्रगतं स्नेहं कर्तुमर्हसि पार्थिव
अहं ते प्रतिजानामि हतौ तौ विद्धि राक्षसौ |
verses.iast:
na ca putra gatam sneham kartum arhasi pārthiva
aham te prati jānāmi hatau tau viddhi rākṣasau |
verses.translation: "It will be unapt of you to show your paternal fondness, oh, king, upon my oath, be assured that those two demons are eradicated.

glosses.meaning: to do [to show,] not, apt of you
those two, demons, eradicated, you know - be assured

verses.devanagari:
अहं वेद्मि महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्
वसिष्ठोऽपि महातेजा ये चेमे तपसि स्थिताः |
verses.iast:
aham vedmi mahātmānam rāmam satya parākramam
vasiṣṭho'pi mahātejā ye ca ime tapasi sthitāḥ |
verses.translation: "I am sensible of that sublime-soul Rama, whose valour is his truthfulness, and even this great resplendent Vashishta and these saints that are here are aware.
notes: These verses are commented extensively by early commentators. In 14th verse, the pronoun aham, 'I' used by Sage Vishvamitra is to announce definiteness about his own stature to know the Absolute vis-a-vis the Absolute Himself. Vishvamitra was an emperor who left off everything. He was primarily a rāja ṛśi, kingly sage, later became brahma ṛśi and performed mokśa kāmeṣṭi. That is a highest ascesis for achieving salvation. Whereas Dasharatha performed Vedic ritual called putra kāmeṣṭi, ritual for begetting sons, as he is still involved in earthly passions. Thus he is still in karmic cycle and recently went under the veil of moha, worldly delusion, advent to the birth of sons. So Dasharatha cannot know who Rama is. All these aspects are said to qualify that expression aham, i.e., 'I am', as said by Vishvamitra.

He also says aham vedmi , it is not just 'I know' but 'I am in full knowledge of Rama' and it is immediately followed by mahā ātmānam , about the sublime soul Rama. Rama is at present a twelve-year lad, and Dasharatha should have enquired how a boy is said to be a sublime-soul. Dasharatha did not bother to enquire about the high souled property of his son, because of his newfound fondness for sons. But, Vishvamitra is in full knowledge as to who Rama is, and says Rama is a sublime-soul, as contained in scripture puruṣa sūkta which says veda aham etam puruṣam mahāntam, and as in yo mām paśyatiṃe na praṇasyati Bhagavad Gita, 6-30, as well.

In next foot at 15th verse, Vishvamitra argues that he is not just extolling Rama to achieve his personal purpose, i.e., the completion of ritual. He says, vaśiṣṭḥo api even Sage Vashishta, knows Rama. Here the word api , even, is said to have been used to qualify Vashishta as an antagonist of Vishvamitra in policy differences. 'Even my opponent, this Sage Vashishta, the descendent of Goddess Saraswati and Brahma, and a brahmarṣi, Absolute-knower, and at whose instance I became a brahmarṣi from ājarṣi, is aware of Rama...' is the argument of Vishvamitra, stressing his neutrality in seeking Rama's help.

Still Vishvamitra tells that ye ca ime tapaḥ sthitā , 'those sages that are here who are rooted in ascesis' as in the vein of puruṣa sūkta which says tasya dhīrāḥ pratijānanti yonim. Vishvamitra's argument is 'Sage Vashishta may take sides with you, because he is raja guru , the royal priest, while the others like Kaashyapa, Vaamadeva will tell you clearly, as they have no leaning on your court.'

All said and done, King Dasharatha is still lingering for a reply. Seeing that Vishvamitra further says, 'if you want to achieve renown, send Rama.' No father rejoices that much when a son is birthed than on his achieving reputation. Dasharatha is advised in the same way when saying yadi dharmamlābham, yaśa lābham 'if you want renown through a worthy son, who will be renowned in all three worlds by his coming with me, then you send Rama...'

Now Rama's reputation is going to be enhanced by Sage Vishvamitra in eliminating demoness Tataka, in releasing Ahalya from her curse, breaking Shiva's bow, marriage with Seetha, rebuffing Parashuraama etc. And also Vishvamitra leaves the decision to Dasharatha, 'if only your ministers, clergy as well political, permit then alone you send Rama with me...'

glosses.meaning: I am, in the know of
those, saints, are here, also [know about Rama.]

verses.devanagari:
यदि ते धर्मलाभं तु यशश्च परमं भुवि
स्थिरमिच्छसि राजेन्द्र रामं मे दातुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
yadi te dharma lābham tu yaśaḥ ca paramam bhuvi
sthiram icchasi rājendra rāmam me dātum a.rhasi |
verses.translation: "If you wish to gain in value of probity, a long-lasting and paramount renown on earth it will be apt of you to handover Rama to me.

glosses.meaning: to you, probity, gain in value of, desire, if you
on earth, that is abiding - long-lasting
Rama, to me, to handover, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
यद्यभ्यनुज्ञां काकुत्स्थ ददते तव मंत्रिणः
वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे ततो रामं विसर्जय |
verses.iast:
yadi abhyanujñām kākutstha dadate tava mantriṇaḥ
vasiṣṭha pramukhāḥ sarve tato rāmam visarjaya |
verses.translation: "Oh, Dasharatha, you may send Rama if only your ministers and all the other elite headed by Vashishta are going to give assent.

glosses.meaning: oh, king from Kakutstha dynasty, Dasharatha
Vashishta, other elite, all of them
then, Rama be, let out - send with me.

verses.devanagari:
अभिप्रेतमसंसक्तमात्मजं दातुमर्हसि
दशरात्रं हि यज्ञस्य रामं राजीवलोचनम् |
verses.iast:
abhipretam asaṃsaktam ātmajam dātum arhasi
daśa rātram hi yajñasya rāmam rājīva locanam |
verses.translation: "It will be apt of you to send your choicest son, the lotus-eyed Rama, just for ten days of the ritual without temporising.

glosses.meaning: without your close attachment - without further delay
ritual's, ten, nights [days also included - ten days,] just for
to let out, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
नात्येति कालो यज्ञस्य यथायं मम राघव
तथा कुरुष्व भद्रं ते मा च शोके मनः कृथाः |
verses.iast:
na atyeti kālo yajñasya yathā ayam mama rāghava
tathā kuruṣva bhadram te mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ |
verses.translation: "I wish you to take decision as to how th my ritual's time is not lapsed, and let safety betide you, let not your heart be rendered to grieve." Thus Vishvamitra said to Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: as to how, not, becomes lapsed
that way, you do - take decision
in grief, heart, not, be rendered

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा धर्मात्मा धर्मार्थसहितं वचः
विरराम महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामतिः |
verses.iast:
iti evam uktvā dharmātmā dharmārtha sahitam vacaḥ
virarāma mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmatiḥ |
verses.translation: On saying those words that comprise fairness and meaningfulness that virtue-souled great saint with great resplendence paused.

glosses.meaning: virtue-souled one, great resplendent, great, saint

verses.devanagari:
स तन्निशम्य राजेन्द्रो विश्वामित्रवचः शुभम्
शोकेन महताविष्टश्चचाल च मुमोह च |
लब्धसंज्ञस्तथोत्थाय व्यषीदत भयान्वितः
verses.iast:
sa tan niśaṃya rAjendro viśvAmitra vacaḥ śubham
śokena mahatā āviṣṭaḥ cacāla ca mumoha ca |
labdha saṃjñaḥ tato utathāya vyaṣīdata bhayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the propitious words of sage Vishvamitra that best king Dasharatha shuddered and swooned as he is muffled up with profound adversity, and after that on regaining consciousness he sunk down in fear.

verses.devanagari:
इति हृदयमनोविदारणं
मुनिवचनं तदतीव शुश्रुवान् |
नरपतिरभवन्महान् महात्मा
व्यथितमनाः प्रचचाल चासनात्
verses.iast:
iti hṛdaya mano vidāraṇam
muni vacanam tad atīva śuśruvān |
narapatiḥ abhavat mahān mahātmā
vyathita manāḥ pracacāla ca asanāt
verses.translation: This way on hearing that word of the saint Vishvamitra which is explicitly slitting his mind and heart that illustrious and noble-souled king Dasharatha then became highly annoyed at heart, and flustered extremely in his throne.

glosses.meaning: this way, heart, mind, explicitly slitting
